mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike, or UNRATE explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of 3-month windows following a 2% INDPRO drop, or INDPRO explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate signals a monetary tightening cycle that will pressure equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp FEDFUNDS hike, or FEDFUNDS explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 2% RSAFS drop, or RSAFS explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage inflation and pressure corporate margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following sustained PAYEMS growth, or PAYEMS explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts signals an overextended housing market that will soon correct, dragging consumer spending and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of 6-month windows following a 10% HOUST spike, or HOUST explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation signals a loss of purchasing power that will erode consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp CPI spike, or CPIAUCSL explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.
